remarks: Tucked away on a quiet Redondo Beach street, this updated 2-bedroom, 3-bath condo offers the space, privacy, and indoor-outdoor living that are hard to find in a traditional condo. Set within an intimate 8-unit complex, the two-story residence has its own private entrance and a welcoming front porch that gives it the feel of a home from the moment you arrive. Inside, high ceilings and all-new recessed LED lighting create a bright, open atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed layout offers comfortable living and dining spaces along with a flexible loft, perfect for a home office, workout space, reading area, or additional lounge. Upstairs, both bedrooms enjoy their own private outdoor spaces.
